title: nexthype
tagline: nexthybe is the next generation creator platform where fans can connect with their favourite creators on a deeper, more meaningful manner
description:
The app is build as a mobile-friendly web interface aimed to improve the creator economy's user experience. One of the biggest pain points of creators, specifically in Live Streams, is that they are unable to see in real time whether users in the stream are their real fans or not.

Hence, by minting a unique NFT for every user that stayed in their live stream for more than 80% of the total duration, users can build a "reputation" that the creator can see in real time when the user comments/interacts with the creator.
how_its_made: The app is made with Coinbase's CDP and uses NFTs generated on BASE to allocate NFTs to the specific user. Every user needs to sign in to a Coinbase account (in the future the idea is that they should be able to do it without needing an existing Coinbase account) to login to the app.
